name: Immuno-Biological Laboratories Co.,Ltd.
summary: Immuno-Biological Laboratories Co., Ltd. (IBL) researches, develops, produces and distributes immunological reagents worldwide. It offers ELISA assay kits for quantitative measurement and research support for fields including cancer, metabolic syndrome and Alzheimer's disease, along with customized services. Its transgenic silkworm technology is used to produce antibodies for research and diagnostics and human collagen for cosmetics.
